title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 2 — Tough Matchup + Favorable Team Step 7
problem: Page 2 has verified matchup evidence but no dedicated Tough Matchup + Favorable Team stage after Best Bet.
root_cause: The existing verified CFB offense-vs-defense matchup owner was not composed into the selected-event Page-2 flow as a concise stage-level summary.
patch: Add a presentation-only Stage 6 summary that reuses the existing verified matchup contract, emits a tough side and/or favorable side only when at least three verified matchup tiles support the existing explicit read, and fails soft without inventing a side. Bind it after Best Bet in the existing Page-2 runtime. No new provider, model, projection, probability, ranking, selection, or sportsbook influence.
